column1: # T-181.2.1 — TBD verdict for every CRF capability. HAND-AUTHORED; product judgement.
# Reforger ships no lobby, briefing, slotting, respawn, spectator or admin tooling. CRF is a
# working framework that covers that ground, so every CRF source file must carry an explicit
# TBD verdict here. `enf capability` fails when any file matches no rule (UNTRIAGED) — that
# is how a forgotten subsystem becomes a build error instead of a surprise before an event.
# LONGEST PREFIX WINS, so a broad directory rule can be overridden by a specific file.
# Verdicts: BUILD | HAVE | PARTIAL | REPLACE | LATER | SKIP | DEFERRED
#   DEFERRED means out of scope BY OPERATOR WORD — see docs/mod/TBD_MOD_DESIGN.md §Deferrals.
